diagnostics.message: The scale_up event source mapping must wait for aws_iam_role_policy.scale_up, which grants its execution role SQS polling permissions. Referencing the function alone does not order creation after this policy and mapping creation can fail with insufficient ReceiveMessage permissions.

When VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.syncer must wait for syncer_vpc_execution_role to grant ENI management permissions; the shared role reference does not order the attachment before function provisioning.
When VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.scale_up must wait for scale_up_vpc_execution_role to grant ENI management permissions before provisioning.
When VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.scale_down must wait for scale_down_vpc_execution_role to grant ENI management permissions before provisioning.
When the pool and VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.pool must wait for pool_vpc_execution_role to grant ENI management permissions before provisioning.
When VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.webhook must wait for webhook_vpc_execution_role to grant ENI management permissions before provisioning.

aws_s3_object.trigger immediately invokes the syncer on deployment and must wait for aws_iam_role_policy.syncer so the invocation can write the runner distribution to S3. The notification dependency does not wait for this execution policy.
aws_s3_object.trigger immediately invokes the syncer and should wait for lambda_logging so the initial invocation has its logging permissions and managed log group ready.
When a KMS key is configured, aws_s3_object.trigger must wait for lambda_kms before invoking the syncer, so its first distribution upload has the required KMS permissions.
